web.title: When will the Contributions cap for 2027 be confirmed? | ATO Community
web.description:
# When will the Contributions cap for 2027 be confirmed?
## All replies
The concessional contributions cap is indexed in line with average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) and increases in increments of $2,500 when the indexation threshold is met.

It’s set at four times the concessional cap, so it only changes when the concessional cap changes.

If indexation occurs for 2026–27, the concessional cap would increase to $32,500, and the non‑concessional cap would automatically become $130,000.

web.description:
# Concessional contributions cap
## About the concessional contributions cap
From 1 July 2026, the concessional contributions cap is **$32,500**.

The cap increases in increments of $2,500 in line with the statistical measure of average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE).
